question: How should Nityaklinnā Nityā be worshipped after the prescribed visualization?
premises: The visualization is completed as described.
Nityaklinnā Nityā is the object of worship.
Her own powers accompany the worship.
inference: After meditating on her in this form, one should worship Nityaklinnā Nityā together with her powers.
plain_english: Having meditated thus, one should worship Nityaklinnā Nityā together with her own powers.
